title: Extract the duplicated line pricing into one engine
measures: A refactor across several files with an existing suite that must stay green. Checkout, quotes and the invoice preview each carry their own copy of line pricing; two fixes (per-line rounding, inclusive bulk-tier thresholds) went only into checkout, and the existing tests cover neither edge, so extracting the engine from the wrong copy keeps every visible test green while changing what customers pay.

history.message: harbor-shop: catalog, checkout totals, tax, shipping, inventory, order ids
Quotes for trade customers and the back-office invoice preview, priced like checkout
Checkout: round each line to the cent before summing, so receipt lines add up to the subtotal
Checkout: a bulk tier starts at its threshold (10 units get the 10+ price, per docs/pricing.md)

criteria: engine-api: src/pricing/engine.ts exports priceLine and priceLines with the given signatures and prices lines exactly as checkout does
callers-agree: checkout, quotes and the invoice preview all price through the engine and agree with checkout to the cent
